name: Toggle Grab
author: shander
description: Makes the Grabber tool toggle on/off with a click instead of requiring you to hold the mouse button. Click once to start grabbing, click again to drop. Includes an on/off setting in the mod's config panel so you can switch back to the default hold-to-grab behavior at any time. No other tool is affected.

enabled.label: Toggle Mode
enabled.description: When on, click once to grab and click again to drop. When off, the Grabber works normally (hold the mouse button).
